# The Old Lumina Empire — Narrative Script

*Audio: 05_The_Old_Lumina_Empire.mp3 — July 22, 2026*

---

From 1729 to 1134 years before the Great Divergence, the Old Lumina Empire dominated the known world. At its height, it controlled seventy percent of the Lumina Continent, the island of Cattos, and significant portions of Tuba. Its cities were marvels of engineering. Its armies were unstoppable. Its bureaucracy was the most sophisticated governance system since the Last Great War.

Its greatest ruler was Luminous the Twelfth, called the Architect. He was brilliant, visionary, and utterly blind to the rot within.

The Shadows had been inside the Empire since its founding. Every institution, every ministry, every military command — seeded with homunculi, guided by Hybrian agents. They did not want the Empire to rule. They wanted it to fall.

In 1134 BGD, the Shadows engineered a war with the Goblin King. A conflict that should have been a trivial border skirmish. They ensured it was not. Through sabotage, through corrupted intelligence, through whispered advice in the right ears, they turned a minor engagement into a catastrophic defeat.

Luminous the Twelfth, watching his life's work crumble, committed suicide. His brother Hoelio died in the fighting. The Empire collapsed within a generation. Marti barbarians invaded from the north. The Pax Lumina — six centuries of stability — ended in fire and blood.

This was Phase One of the Shadow plan in action: Infiltration. Seed the institutions. Wait. When the moment is right, make them fall. The Lumina Empire was the first great test. It would not be the last.
